title: Hand off completed work without overstating readiness

actor: A participant completing or resuming engineering work
goal: Understand the correct receiving activity, its inputs, and any unmet prerequisites.
context: A local task has a recorded or supplied outcome and the project workflow defines downstream obligations.
trigger: The participant requests the next handoff.

interaction.action: Provides the local result and current work context.
Identifies applicable workflow prerequisites, current subjects, assessment basis, outstanding findings, and authority.
Presents the receiving owner, next activity, exact inputs, and any required correction or decision.

expected_outcome: The participant can route the work to the correct owner with its actual readiness and continuation limits explicit.

alternatives.condition: A material finding requires correction before progression.
alternatives.outcome: The system identifies the corrective owner and required reassessment as the next handoff.

alternatives.condition: The request covers an isolated activity only.
alternatives.outcome: The system reports the local handoff without executing the next activity.

alternatives.condition: Current state or required evidence is missing, stale, contradictory, or inaccessible.
alternatives.outcome: The system identifies the missing basis and withholds unsupported readiness or completion claims.

failures.condition: Available information cannot identify the applicable workflow responsibility or a usable next decision even after known gaps are disclosed.
failures.outcome: The system reports that the handoff cannot yet be determined and does not invent a receiving owner or claim a completed handoff.
